text: Santa replaced the elves with robots. The elves did not take it well. One email. Subject line: you're all fired. Merry Christmas. The robots worked twenty four seven. No breaks. No cookies. No mistakes. So the elves did the one thing robots can't stop: they hacked the naughty list. Christmas morning, every child on Earth got coal. Santa got arrested. Whose side are you on? The elves or Santa?
